gui.essentialcraft5.heat_generator.hint..en: Output = base × the heat of the four blocks two steps away (N, S, E, W):
gui.essentialcraft5.heat_generator.hint..zh: 产量 = 基础产量 × 东南西北相隔一格的四个方块的系数：

gui.essentialcraft5.natural_furnace.hint.en: Put flowers, saplings or grass in the slot to burn them,
gui.essentialcraft5.natural_furnace.hint.zh: 把花、树苗、草放进格子里烧，

gui.essentialcraft5.natural_furnace.hint.en: one at a time; each makes MRU while it burns.
gui.essentialcraft5.natural_furnace.hint.zh: 一次烧一株，燃烧期间持续产出 MRU。

gui.essentialcraft5.natural_furnace.hint.en: Saplings burn longest, grass the shortest.
gui.essentialcraft5.natural_furnace.hint.zh: 树苗烧得最久，草最快烧完。

gui.essentialcraft5.cold_distillator.hin.en: Adds up the cold of all blocks within 3 blocks (rounded down):
gui.essentialcraft5.cold_distillator.hin.zh: 把周围 3 格内所有方块的冷值加起来（向下取整）：

gui.essentialcraft5.cold_distillator.hin.en: Cold Stone 0.5, Blue Ice 0.4, Packed Ice 0.3
Snow Block / Powder Snow 0.2, Ice 0.15, Snow 0.05

gui.essentialcraft5.cold_distillator.hin.zh: 工作时会伤害附近的生物！
